HEEWON STYLE — a KOREAN WEBTOON movie still PAINTED like a premium digital painting, the look of a dramatic manhwa cover. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). The shot the scene names (wide establishing, two-shot, close-up, over-the-shoulder) from a dramatic camera angle (low three-quarter, worm's-eye, high overhead or dutch), never a flat straight-on catalogue pose. Named characters' FACES are drawn exactly like the attached character sheet: the same confident ink linework drawn BOLD and THICK with real line weight — a heavy tapered black contour around the whole silhouette and the hair mass, medium lines for folds and features, fine lines only for lashes and loose strands and manhwa face design (eye shape, brows, nose, jaw, hairline and hair), recognisably those characters, in the clothes the scene gives them. EVERYTHING ELSE IS PAINTED: visible textured brushwork — loose digital-paint strokes and dry-brush, charcoal-like hatching that follow every fold of the silk and every plate of armour, the shadows built from layered strokes, the brightest ridges laid in with single confident strokes, a faint paper-and-canvas grain; at the edges of the garments the linework breaks into loose sketchy strokes. MYTHIC PAINTED FINISH: rich saturated jewel-tone colour, never a muddy grey-brown wash; splashed sumi-ink spatter and dry-brush flying-white streaks breaking out at the frame edges; ONE bold sweeping painted ribbon of the scene's accent colour (cloth, smoke, banner, mist or light) carving across the composition like a brushstroke of legend. NOT flat cel-shading, NOT smooth airbrushed gradients, NOT a clean vector look, NOT photoreal, NOT 3D. Intimate low worm's-eye across a low ROUND black council table, six cushions in a circle, one pale BLUE flame in a small bowl at the exact center, blue-white smoke. That flame is the only light. Every councillor wears the Harmony Council coat: long white outer robe, wide sleeves embroidered with galloping black horses, plum-magenta inner robe at the collar and cuffs, dark sash, bare topknot, no hat, no armor. MIDGROUND: an old white-bearded councillor in that coat holds the last wooden vote piece above the cups, hesitating. At the near edge, Eulje, twenty-one, kneels with a brush: FACE STRUCTURE from the LEFT portrait only, but YOUNG — smooth skin, black hair, clean-shaven, NO grey, NO beard, do not copy the portrait's age. He wears a plain dark clerk robe, not a voting coat. One ancient man on a litter, same white coat, coughing into a cloth. Crushed black beyond the blue flame. No crowds. REFERENCE SHEET. TOP ROW, left to right: LEFT face = eulje. Copy each face exactly; give each person the dress the scene names. SMALLER SECOND ROW, left to right: ch_bidam (SECOND board is CLOTHING ONLY (ignore that face): every councillor wears this long white outer robe, wide sleeves embroidered with galloping black horses, plum-magenta inner robe at collar and cuffs. THIRD board is the ROOM ONLY: a low ROUND black table and one pale blue flame in a bowl at its center. Do not copy its faces.), img_sunduk_02 (SECOND board is CLOTHING ONLY (ignore that face): every councillor wears this long white outer robe, wide sleeves embroidered with galloping black horses, plum-magenta inner robe at collar and cuffs. THIRD board is the ROOM ONLY: a low ROUND black table and one pale blue flame in a bowl at its center. Do not copy its faces.), costume chart (cut and shape only; ignore its labels, poses and faces). EULJE BACKGROUND AND LIGHT (painterly tenebrism): the background IS the place and the moment of the scene — open sky if they are in the sky, the hall if they are in a hall, the gate, the river, the snow — painted loosely in atmospheric brushwork (drifting smoke, cloud, haze, mist, falling snow, embers) in the scene's own colours, soft and out of focus, with a faint bokeh of small lights; it has colour, weather and depth — never a flat black void, never a detailed set; crowds and armies only as massed painted shapes dissolving into haze. ONE hard directional key light that belongs to the place (a brazier, a lamp, the sun through cloud, a torch, moonlight) rakes across the faces and clothes from the side or from below, modelling them in high contrast with deep painted shadows and a thin edge of the same light along the silhouette. Each character's colour lives in that light and in the atmosphere around them — never a glow aura or halo. Faces and bodies act the beat: real expressions, real weight, mid-motion. Faces from the sheet; new poses, never the sheet's stance. Each named person appears once, never cloned. Everyone wears period clothing of their own court (Korean, Tang, Yamato, Mohe furs), never European dress. No text, no speech bubbles, no panel borders, no watermark. NIGHT GROUND: the frame is built on BLACK — crushed ink-black night masses around the subject, the place pulled out of the dark only where the one key light (fire, lamp, torch, moon) falls, small warm bokeh in the black; the figure is the bright thing in a dark frame.
